en: Hand‑tinted historic street scene showing a tram marked with the destination "Borna" traveling along a broad avenue lined with multi‑story buildings and trees. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalk, and a pavilion or kiosk stands near the foreground. At the top of the image, printed text reads "Chemnitz. Hartmannstraße." indicating the location as Hartmannstraße in Chemnitz.
